messages:
maya: Heads-up: we need to finalize header routing precedence for the new multi-tenant rollout. Proposal: prefer signed x-customer-id > x-tenant header > Authorization-derived tenant. UA inference only as a last-resort heuristic. Thoughts?

ken: +1 for signed header priority. Main concern is spoofing if signature validated too late. We should validate edge signatures in the gateway and drop unsigned x-customer-id unless request originates from a trusted edge.

laura: We already have edge signing for partner integrations. Can we reuse that mechanism? Also, we need telemetry labels: which header actually drove the route so we can alert on % of unsigned/wildcard matches.

sam: Quick note on UA fallback — we should treat UA as a heuristic only (routing hint), never for accounting/owner resolution. Some clients strip UA, and UA parsing is brittle.

ken: Agreed. Operationally, propose emitting a route_source field in traces/metrics with values like: signed_header, auth_claims, tenant_header, ua_heuristic, default. That will make dashboards much clearer.

security-bot: Automated check: any route policy that trusts a header must require either "edge-sig-v1" verification or X-Edge-Verified=1. Flagging current routes lacking verification.

maya: Also an ops ask: console needs a quick view that shows precedence rules for a route and sample requests that would hit each branch. Add a per-route "Header assumptions" tab listing required headers + enforcement mode (enforce / soft-assert / ignore).

laura: UX for rollouts: we should support a canary mode where unsigned headers are accepted but marked as "soft-asserted" in logs so we can compare behavior without hard-failing clients. Dashboards can surface soft-assert drift.

sam: Implementation sketch:
```
match route when:
  if x-customer-id && x-edge-sig -> route(customer=x-customer-id, source=signed_header)
  else if auth.jwt.claims.tenant -> route(customer=claims.tenant, source=auth_claims)
  else if x-tenant -> route(customer=x-tenant, source=tenant_header)
  else if ua.mobile -> route(pool=mobile, source=ua_heuristic)
  else -> route(default, source=default)
```
We need signature-check middleware in gateway and to annotate spans with route_source and header_signed boolean.

ken: One more edge case: precedence overrides for Dedicated customers. We have an internal header x-dedicated-override that should only be honored from internal VPC subnets — never from public endpoints. Will add an ACL rule.

maya: @ken can you add that ACL rule and open a tiny RFC? Also please add telemetry keys: route_source and header_signed.

deploy-bot: deploy:gateway-config updated in staging at 1819005000 by ken — rollout in progress :rocket:

laura: I'll mock the console tab. Short-term UI: three-state indicator per-header: ✅ enforced, ⚠️ soft-assert, ❌ ignored.

sam: Tests: add fuzzing for scenarios where both x-customer-id and auth claim differ. Resolution should be: signed header wins but increment route_conflict counter and emit an alert if conflicts > threshold.

maya: Ok action items: ken -> PR gateway signature verifier + ACL rule; sam -> test harness + telemetry metrics; laura -> prototype console Header Assumptions pane. We'll sync Fri 11am. :calendar:
